scenes.vo: India scored seven hundred and twenty. And still couldn't win.
scenes.cap: India scored 720. And still couldn't win.

scenes.vo: New Zealand made three sixty eight. So India led by three hundred and fifty two.
Here's the catch. To win a Test, you usually have to bowl the other team out twice. Big runs only buy you time.
scenes.cap: To win a Test you usually need to bowl them out TWICE

scenes.vo: New Zealand batted a hundred and twenty overs in their second innings, and lost only five wickets.
scenes.cap: NZ 2nd innings: 120 overs, only 5 wickets down

scenes.vo: When the captains shook hands, they were two thirty nine for five. Still a hundred and thirteen runs behind.
So India's winless run in New Zealand, going back to March two thousand nine, goes on.
scenes.cap: India's winless Test run in NZ dates back to March 2009

scenes.vo: Second Test, Christchurch, November twenty seven. Can India take twenty wickets this time?
